## The question

Phage therapy uses viruses that kill bacteria. As antibiotics fail more often, it is one of the most watched alternatives. This project asked: who is inventing phage therapies, in which countries, and how fast is the field moving? We answered it with machine learning on large patent datasets.

## Where we are

| Step | Status |
|---|---|
| Build and clean the global patent dataset | Done |
| Analyse inventors, applicants, countries and technologies | Done |
| Share the method as a protocol | Done · January 2024 |
| Publish the results in Nature Biotechnology | Done · December 2024 |
| Next steps | To be announced |

## Team

- **Maxime Descartes Mbogning Fonkou**, lead author. All co-authors are listed in the article.

## We are looking for

- Teams working on phage therapy or antimicrobial resistance who would like a deeper or updated analysis, for example on clinical trials, funding or specific bacteria
